description: This file defines the class TemplateDirIterator in the Twig\[Util"] namespace, which extends IteratorIterator and overrides methods to return file contents and keys as strings. It is part of the Twig templating engine's utility classes.

classes.name: TemplateDirIterator
classes.description: A class extending IteratorIterator that retrieves file contents and keys as strings during iteration.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the content of the current file as a string.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current element as a string.
